"import cadquery as cq

# Hard-coded parameters (mm)
plate_length = 110.0   # X
plate_width = 70.0    # Y
plate_height = 12.0   # Z, base face at z=0
boss_diameter = 40.0
boss_height = 25.0
hole_diameter = 9.0
hole_offset_x = 41.0
hole_offset_y = 21.0

# Four bolt-hole centers
hole_locations = [
    ( hole_offset_x,  hole_offset_y),
    ( hole_offset_x, -hole_offset_y),
    (-hole_offset_x,  hole_offset_y),
    (-hole_offset_x, -hole_offset_y),
]

# Build the base plate (centered in XY, base at z=0)
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(plate_length, plate_width)
    .extrude(plate_height)
)

# Cut four through-holes in the plate only
result = (
    result.faces(">Z").workplane()
    .pushPoints(hole_locations)
    .circle(hole_diameter / 2.0)
    .cutThruAll()
)

# Add the central cylindrical boss on top of the plate
result = (
    result.faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(boss_diameter / 2.0)
    .extrude(boss_height)
)

# Export to STEP
cq.exporters.export(result, "part.step")"
